name: welcome_creator
subject: Welcome to Creator's Economy — here's your referral link
html:
Hi {{creatorName}},

You're in. Your Creator's Economy application has been approved.

Your referral link: {{referralLink}}

Your first month is completely free — no performance threshold applies. Use Insytiq, love it, share it. You earn 40% recurring commission on every paying user you refer.

To keep free access from month 2: hit 3 paying conversions OR 100 clicks in any rolling 30-day window.

Dashboard: {{dashboardUrl}}
— Insytiq Team

name: conversion_alert
subject: You just earned ${{commissionAmount}}
html:
Hi {{creatorName}},

Someone signed up for Insytiq's {{planType}} plan via your referral link. Commission: ${{commissionAmount}} (clears from 30-day hold in 30 days)

Dashboard: {{dashboardUrl}}

name: access_renewed
subject: Your Creator's Economy access is renewed ✓
html:
Hi {{creatorName}},

Great work. You hit the threshold — free access renewed for next 30 days. Clicks: {{clicksLast30}} | Conversions: {{conversionsLast30}}

Dashboard: {{dashboardUrl}}

name: access_paused
subject: Your Creator's Economy access has been paused
html:
Hi {{creatorName}},

Your free access is paused this month.

subject: Your grace period has ended
html:
Hi {{creatorName}},

Your first free month is complete. From today, access is evaluated on a rolling 30-day basis. Hit 3 conversions OR 100 clicks to keep it free.
